---
title: "Pathopath quick tour"
output: rmarkdown::html_vignette
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Pathopath quick tour}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
---

```r
chrf <- read.csv(system.file("extdata","CHRF_2021.csv", package = "pathopath"))
pw   <- pp_build_pathways(chrf, resolution = "ward", date_format = "%d/%m/%y")
edges <- pp_compute_contacts(pw, dt = 0, d0 = 1)
net   <- pp_build_network(edges)
pp_plot_network(net$graph, edges)
```
